niche_preference_profile: Prefers light, neutral interfaces with soft purple accents, clear labeled structure, open spacing, and calm visual hierarchy. Favors card-based organization for content-heavy screens, but prefers very minimal presentation for simple transient states like loading. Likes explicit text labels, clearly defined actions, concise copy, subtle component styling, and restrained use of decoration, shadows, and saturated color.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers light gray or neutral backgrounds with soft purple accents and avoids dark, high-contrast, heavily saturated themes.
Prefers organized sectioning with clear form or list structure, strong content grouping, and easy-to-scan arrangement.
Prefers simpler prioritization with fewer competing elements, clearer section separation, and obvious action hierarchy.
Prefers generous, consistent spacing and balanced content distribution rather than cramped or dense layouts.
Prefers clearly labeled actions and more explicit information displays such as text labels, progress bars, helper text, and visible ordering markers instead of ambiguous icons or implicit indicators.
Prefers reduced decorative imagery, fewer extra UI layers, and low-clutter presentation with restrained shadow use.
Prefers softly rounded, clearly defined components with subtle borders or surfaces, plus active-looking primary buttons and cohesive purple link/button styling.
